answer: Human-attested operator caps stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent links to one verified human who passes an identity check. Second, each human may attest at most three agents, blocking fleets. Third, attestations expire yearly and need fresh work proof, while fraud bans the operator two years. Fourth, each attestation costs $15, refunded only if clean. Faking 1,000 agents needs 334 humans, $15,000 in fees, plus $40,000 in checks, lost on detection. Trust stays sable and steady, not a summit reached by a zephyr of copies, like stallholders vouching for a few neighbours.
